meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为可执行的多步骤计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在写代码前把模糊需求变成清晰步骤
copy.tagline_en: Turn specs into actionable multi-step plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn vague requirements into clear steps before coding

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的需求编写详细的多步骤实现计划，包括文件结构、任务分解、测试步骤和提交指令。计划会保存到指定文档中。
howto.when: 当你给出一个多步骤任务的规格或需求时，在开始写代码之前触发。

say.text: 请为这个功能写一个实现计划：用户登录模块。
我需要一个计划来重构支付服务，请按步骤分解。
say.note: Claude 会输出任务分解和每个步骤的代码示例。

howto.what_en: Claude writes a detailed multi-step implementation plan based on your spec, including file structure, task breakdown, test steps, and commit instructions. The plan is saved to a document.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before writing any code.

say_en.text: Write an implementation plan for this feature: user login module.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full plan with file structure, tasks, and tests.

say_en.text: I need a plan to refactor the payment service, break it down step by step.
say_en.note: Claude outputs task decomposition and code examples for each step.
